name: handoff_integrity_review

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
r=json.loads(Path('results.json').read_text());o=json.loads(Path('originals.json').read_text());assert len(r)==20 and set(r)==set(o)
for k,v in o.items():
 assert 'statement' in v['statement_tokens'];assert v['statement_tokens']['statement']['decoded']==v['record']['statement'];assert v['newline']
for name in ['search-screen-response.json','search-followup-response.json','search-last-response.json']:
 s=json.loads(Path(name).read_text());print(name,'full response chars',len(s));assert len(s)>100
print('QUARANTINE metadata known matching2209.15312: not fetched or reused; parent metadata only, no acquired bodies accessed')
print('COUNTS',len(r),'SOURCEFILES',len(list(Path('sources').iterdir())))
for p in sorted(Path('.').glob('*.receipt.json')):
 q=json.loads(p.read_text());print(p.name,'exit',q['exit'],'killed',q['killed'])
s=Path('ACTUALBRIEF.md').read_text().replace('Other16 original primary bodies were not acquired','Sixteen targets received no primary-body acquisition;17 original cited bodies remain unread (356877 received only a later primary claim)')
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'ACTUALBRIEF.md'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0
